response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack and systems software engineer with strong web, backend, and some low-latency/embedded experience, but has no demonstrated background in SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator hardware, GPU architecture, or deep-learning workload performance optimization, which are core requirements for this Principal Performance Architect role.
strengths: Long, diverse technical career with senior/staff-level roles
Experience with low-latency systems and async I/O in DLang
Demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring, and community contributions
concerns: No evidence of SoC/IP modeling or hardware architecture experience
No AI/deep-learning workload optimization or GPU architecture background
No indication of security clearance eligibility or export-control experience
